exercises.title: Store the summary: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW
exercises.problemHtml:
Create the materialized view note_summary_mv (user_id, notes, tong_views) — per user, number of notes and total views — so the dashboard reads 20 stored rows instead of aggregating 500.

Sample tables (chapter 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Requirements

  • CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW note_summary_mv AS SELECT … GROUP BY user_id.
  • It stores rows: later writes are NOT reflected until a refresh.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Tạo materialized view note_summary_mv (user_id, notes, tong_views) — theo user, số ghi chú và tổng views — để dashboard đọc 20 dòng đã lưu thay vì tổng hợp 500 dòng.

Bảng mẫu (chương 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW note_summary_mv AS SELECT … GROUP BY user_id.
  • Nó lưu dòng: các lần ghi sau KHÔNG hiện ra cho tới khi làm mới.

starterCodeJson.name: notes12.sql

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW note_summary_mv AS
SELECT user_id, count(*) AS notes, sum(views) AS tong_views
FROM notes
GROUP BY user_id;

solutionCodeJson.name: notes12.sql

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A materialized view runs its query once and stores the result like a table (it can even be indexed). Reads are fast; the data is as old as the last REFRESH.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Materialized view chạy truy vấn một lần và lưu kết quả như một bảng (đánh chỉ mục được). Đọc nhanh; dữ liệu cũ bằng lần REFRESH gần nhất.

exercises.title: Refresh without blocking the dashboard
exercises.problemHtml:
note_summary_mv is stale. A plain REFRESH locks out readers while it runs. Make the view refreshable concurrently and refresh it that way.

Sample tables (chapter 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

This task already has note_summary_mv, built BEFORE user 1's notes gained 100 views each.

Requirements

  • CONCURRENTLY needs a UNIQUE index on the materialized view (here: user_id).
  • Then REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY note_summary_mv.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
note_summary_mv đã cũ. REFRESH thường chặn người đọc trong lúc chạy. Làm cho view làm mới được đồng thời và làm mới theo cách đó.

Bảng mẫu (chương 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Bài này đã có sẵn note_summary_mv, dựng TRƯỚC khi mỗi ghi chú của user 1 được cộng 100 views.

Yêu cầu

  • CONCURRENTLY cần một chỉ mục UNIQUE trên materialized view (ở đây: user_id).
  • Rồi REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY note_summary_mv.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX note_summary_mv_user ON note_summary_mv (user_id);   -- lets PostgreSQL diff old vs new rows
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY note_summary_mv;                   -- readers keep reading the old rows meanwhile

solutionCodeJson.name: notes12-mv.sql

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: CONCURRENTLY builds the new result aside, compares it with the old one through the unique key, and applies only the differences — readers are never blocked. It is slower overall and needs the unique index.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: CONCURRENTLY dựng kết quả mới ở bên cạnh, so với kết quả cũ qua khoá unique, rồi chỉ áp phần khác biệt — người đọc không bao giờ bị chặn. Tổng thể chậm hơn và cần chỉ mục unique.

kiem.moTa: User 1 now shows the new total|||User 1 giờ hiện tổng mới
kiem.kiemTra: SELECT user_id, tong_views FROM note_summary_mv WHERE user_id IN (1, 2) ORDER BY user_id

kiem.moTa: A unique index exists on the view|||Có chỉ mục unique trên view
kiem.kiemTra: SELECT count(*) AS unique_indexes FROM pg_index WHERE indrelid = 'note_summary_mv'::regclass AND indisunique

mistakesJson.loi: Plain REFRESH on a busy dashboard: every reader waits until it finishes.|||REFRESH thường trên dashboard đông: mọi người đọc phải chờ tới khi xong.
CONCURRENTLY without the unique index — it errors.|||CONCURRENTLY mà thiếu chỉ mục unique — báo lỗi.

exercises.title: A daily revenue table for the dashboard (CT Shop)
exercises.problemHtml:
Create mv_daily_revenue (day, payments, revenue): per calendar day of payment.paid_at (Vietnam time), the number of payments and their sum. Give it a unique index on day. The check adds a payment, refreshes, and expects the new numbers.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • paid_at::date AS day (the session is in Vietnam time).
  • CREATE UNIQUE INDEX … ON mv_daily_revenue (day).

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.title: View or materialized view?
exercises.problemHtml:
Choose for each need.

This set has 3 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper or in psql on your own PostgreSQL), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chọn cho từng nhu cầu.

Bộ này có 3 câu. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Hãy tự giải trước (ra giấy hoặc chạy trong psql trên PostgreSQL của bạn) rồi mới kiểm — giải thích sau khi Nộp nói rõ vì sao phương án "trông đúng" lại sai.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# View or materialized view? — answer key

1. A checkout page must show the stock that is on the shelf right now.Trang thanh toán phải hiện tồn kho đang có trên kệ ngay lúc này.
   Answer: b) a plain view (or the table) — it must never be stale
   Correctness beats speed when users act on the number.VI: Khi người dùng hành động theo con số thì đúng quan trọng hơn nhanh.

2. A yearly sales report scans 50 million rows and is opened 200 times a day; yesterday's numbers are fine.Báo cáo doanh số năm quét 50 triệu dòng và được mở 200 lần mỗi ngày; số liệu của hôm qua là đủ.
   Answer: c) a materialized view refreshed nightly
   Compute once, read 200 times. A REFRESH per night costs one scan.VI: Tính một lần, đọc 200 lần. Mỗi đêm một lần REFRESH tốn đúng một lượt quét.

3. What does REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW (without CONCURRENTLY) do to readers?REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW (không CONCURRENTLY) làm gì với người đọc?
   Answer: d) blocks them until it finishes (exclusive lock)
   A plain refresh swaps in the new data under an exclusive lock; CONCURRENTLY avoids that at the price of a unique index and more work.VI: Làm mới thường tráo dữ liệu mới dưới khoá độc quyền; CONCURRENTLY tránh được điều đó với cái giá là chỉ mục unique và nhiều việc hơn.
